note: Use F=(a+b+c)Q with Q=a^2+b^2+c^2-ab-bc-ca and 2Q=(a-b)^2+(b-c)^2+(c-a)^2. Necessity: F divisible by 3 implies S=a+b+c divisible by 3 because x^3 congruent x mod 3; then Q=S^2-3(ab+bc+ca) is divisible by 3, so 9 divides F. Sufficiency: N=3t+1 use (t+1,t,t), whose S=N,Q=1; N=3t+2 use (t+1,t+1,t), whose S=N,Q=1; N=9k with k>=1 use (k+1,k,k-1), whose S=3k,Q=3; N=0 use (0,0,0). This is a complete self-contained proof requiring no predecessor facts.
